mapper.sql: TASKID, TASKNO, TASKNAME, TASKTYPE, ANALYSISTYPE, DATASOURCE, DATARANGE, ANALYSISPARAMETERS, MODELID, SCHEDULETYPE, SCHEDULECRON, TASKSTATUS, STARTTIME, ENDTIME, EXECUTIONTIME, ANALYSISRESULT, RESULTFORMAT, RESULTPATH, ERRORMESSAGE, EXECUTEUSER, REMARK, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE TASKSTATUS = 'PENDING' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE TASKSTATUS = 'RUNNING' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY STARTTIME ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE TASKSTATUS = 'FAILED' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY UPDATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE MODELID = #{modelId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE DATASOURCE = #{dataSource} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE SCHEDULETYPE = 'SCHEDULED' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE TASKSTATUS = 'RUNNING' AND STARTTIME < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY STARTTIME ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS SET STARTTIME = #{startTime}, ENDTIME = #{endTime}, EXECUTIONTIME = #{executionTime}, TASKSTATUS = #{taskStatus}, EXECUTEUSER = #{executeUser}, UPDATETIME = NOW() WHERE TASKID = #{taskId}
UPDATE TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS SET ANALYSISRESULT = #{analysisResult}, RESULTPATH = #{resultPath}, TASKSTATUS = #{taskStatus}, UPDATETIME = NOW(), UPDATEUSER = #{updateUser} WHERE TASKID = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT TASKTYPE as taskType, COUNT(*) as taskCount, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) as percentage FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY TASKTYPE ORDER BY taskCount DESC

SELECT TASKSTATUS as taskStatus, COUNT(*) as taskCount, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) as percentage FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY TASKSTATUS ORDER BY taskCount DESC

SELECT ANALYSISTYPE as analysisType, COUNT(*) as usageCount FROM TBL_DATA_ANALYSIS_TASKS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY ANALYSISTYPE ORDER BY usageCount DESC
